title: Managing many bands and training young players
summary: Laine explains that Manuel Marlowe, Vega and his son ran bands under his instructions, then recalls the first kids he taught horn and how the Brunies boys lived at his home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees
